summary: Iteration 47 testing complete. All new Activity Templates & Phase Activities rework features verified working: 1) Activity Templates Master Data page at /activity-templates with combo key filtering (Technology, Sub-Technology, Project Type), 2) SAP S/4HANA Private Cloud Implementation template with 6 phases (Discover, Prepare, Explore, Realize, Deploy, Run) and SAP Activate methodology items, 3) Reworked Activities Modal with multi-phase selection, bulk adopt, wave-specific activities, and Export Excel, 4) Main Excel export includes activities sheets per wave. Backend API tests: 14/14 passed.

issues: Console warnings about chart width/height being -1 - minor recharts sizing issue (pre-existing)

critical_code_review_comments: ActivityTemplates.js: Clean implementation with combo key filtering (technology_id, sub_technology_id, project_type_id, phase_name), proper CRUD operations, collapsible phase sections

PhaseActivitiesModal.js: Well-structured modal with multi-phase selection using Checkbox component, bulk adopt endpoint integration, wave-specific activities (wave_activities field), separate Excel export

activities.py router: Proper REST API design with combo key matching, bulk adopt endpoint preserves existing wave_activities, seed-sap endpoint creates 6 SAP Activate phases with activities/deliverables
excelExport.js: Activities sheets properly grouped by wave, sorted by phase_ranges order, distinguishes template vs wave-specific items with different colors
seed_data_creation: Used existing PRJ-0026 v3 project (6856eeac-928e-4ada-a478-4c2eccad51d8) with 2 waves (Wave1 SF, Wave2 India) and 5 phases each. SAP template already seeded for Technology=SAP S/4HANA, Sub-Tech=Private Cloud, Project Type=Implementation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 47 verified Activity Templates & Phase Activities rework: 1) Activity Templates page at /activity-templates - select Technology + Sub-Technology + Project Type to view/edit templates. SAP S/4HANA + Private Cloud + Implementation shows 6 phases with SAP Activate methodology items. 2) Activities Modal in estimator - click Activities button in toolbar, shows wave selector, adopt template section with multi-phase checkboxes, phase cards with activity/deliverable counts. Click phase card to edit template activities and wave-specific items. 3) Export Excel buttons work in both main toolbar and Activities modal. Backend routes: /api/activity-templates (combo key CRUD), /api/projects/{id}/activities/adopt-templates (bulk adopt), /api/projects/{id}/activities/{wave}/{phase} (with wave_activities field).

feature1_activity_templates_page.details: Activity Templates page at /activity-templates loads correctly. Filters by Technology, Sub-Technology, Project Type. SAP S/4HANA + Private Cloud + Implementation shows 6 phases (Discover, Prepare, Explore, Realize, Deploy, Run) with correct activity/deliverable counts. Clicking phase expands to show activities and deliverables with SAP Activate methodology items (DDA, Clean Core, etc.).

feature2_activities_modal_rework.details: Activities Modal opens from estimator toolbar. Shows wave selector, adopt template section with Technology/Sub-Tech/Project Type selectors pre-filled from project. Multi-phase selection with checkboxes works - 'Select All' selects all 5 phases, 'Adopt for N Phase(s)' button shows correct count. Phase cards show activity/deliverable/wave counts.

feature3_multi_phase_adopt.details: Bulk adopt endpoint POST /api/projects/{id}/activities/adopt-templates works. Adopts templates for multiple phases at once, preserves existing wave_activities. Backend test verified adoption for Realize (single) and Prepare/Explore/Deploy (multiple).

feature4_wave_specific_activities.details: Phase editor shows template Activities, template Deliverables, and Wave-Specific Additions sections. Add buttons for wave activities/deliverables visible. wave_activities field persisted correctly via PUT endpoint.

feature5_activities_excel_export.details: Export Excel button in Activities modal works - shows 'Activities exported to Excel' toast. Creates separate Excel file with activities grouped by wave.

feature6_main_excel_with_activities.details: Main Export button in estimator toolbar works - shows 'Exported to Excel successfully' toast. Excel includes Activities sheets per wave alongside Milestones sheets.

feature7_backend_api.details: 14/14 backend tests passed. Templates CRUD with combo key, bulk adopt, project activities with wave_activities, export data endpoint, seed-sap endpoint all working.
